checkpoints.what: Both families in one checkpoint. The lane holds two families that share one host, one official form and one caption-mode policy, so the second was finished within the hour the first was; holding the first back would have returned the same diff later.

laterReturn.note: This worker held PF02, PF03, PF05 and PF06 together and checkpointed by COMMIT rather than by five-family batch: no single lane reached five completed families, and the checkpoint rule's purpose — not holding a whole assignment back for the last family — is served by six commits landing as each family finished.
